desc: Built on our field-proven inertia recoil system, engineered with precision and tailored for the avid hunter, our all new SORIX boasts an array of features designed to elevate your shooting experience. The receiver has an aggressive competition cut for easier and faster reloading. Featuring an oversized bolt release button (slammer button), charging handle, and safety to ensure seamless operation in less-than-ideal conditions. The SORIX was designed for all hunters and shooters, even our left-handed customers. Utilizing our SHIFT SYSTEM it allows users to easily swap the charging handle and safety to have a left-handed shotgun experience.
